drhp.business: Pelatro Limited is a global technology company that provides customer engagement and monetisation solutions to telecom operators and digital businesses. Its flagship mViva platform enables operators to understand subscriber behaviour and to design, execute and measure personalised, contextual engagement across the customer lifecycle; at the end of FY26 it was deployed across 46 telecom networks, processing data for approximately 1.5 billion consumers with more than 20,000 campaigns executed. risks.note: Revenue is derived from a focused base of telecom operators, so the loss, consolidation or financial stress of a large customer would bite; mitigation is geographic diversification, deeper engagement across the expanded product portfolio and a high share of recurring revenue.

Enterprise licensing cycles can be long and uneven, causing quarter-to-quarter variability; management explicitly tracks growth year-on-year rather than sequentially because quarterly comparison is not representative given the long sales and implementation cycles. A growing recurring and re-occurring base and a strong contracted order position reduce the exposure.
risks.risk: Revenue variability from long, lumpy enterprise licensing cycles

risks.note: The pace of change in AI and customer-engagement technology requires sustained product investment to stay competitive; the Company points to continuous innovation, illustrated by the launch of its Agentic AI platform.

A significant proportion of revenue and assets is denominated in foreign currencies, exposing the Company to currency movements; it monitors FX fluctuations closely on an ongoing basis to determine corrective steps.
The Company must integrate acquired businesses and realise expected synergies; the Estel integration progressed during the year with margin improvement targeted over the medium term.
The nature of enterprise contracts can extend collection cycles; the Company actively manages credit exposure and the timing of collections.
The business depends on skilled technology and delivery professionals; the Company invests in talent acquisition, development and retention.

The Company operates across multiple jurisdictions and is subject to evolving legal and regulatory requirements, including data-protection and labour regulations such as the New Labour Codes notified during the year; it closely monitors regulatory change.
risks.risk: Regulatory and compliance risk across multiple jurisdictions
